items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: It's the same name as Freddie Kepard. You see? Yes. Now, that's my oldest brother I had.

ctx.x: You pronounce that Kepard sort of a French accent.
K-E-P-A-R-D Kepard. It's the same name as Freddie Kepard. You see? Yes. Now, that's my oldest brother I had. I had four altogether, but the rest of the other two died while I was young.
You might give your birth date if you don't mind.
